title: Solutions
description: Production-ready DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Models and edge AI software solutions from Infineon — the fastest way to production in the Hub.
long_description: The Solutions section features fully developed models and applications you can download, evaluate on supported hardware, and integrate into your product—without training a model from scratch. Solutions skip the full model development cycle and give you field-proven models already optimized for Infineon MCUs. Each solution includes metadata for sensors, target devices, compatible kits, application domains, and performance metrics (memory usage, inference time, and power where available). Solutions are maintained by Infineon and are not open for community contribution.

steps.text: Open the DEEPCRAFT™ AI Hub and browse the Solutions section, or filter by sensor, device, kit, or application domain.
Select a solution to view its description, compatible hardware, and performance metrics.
Product details, use cases, and documentation on Infineon.com.
Download the evaluation package or open an interactive demo (where available).
Most Ready Models offer an evaluation download through Infineon Software Tools. The DEEPCRAFT™ Voice Assistant also provides an online demo.
Confirm the solution supports your target kit and device (PSOC™ 6, PSOC™ Edge, or radar sensor) in the Hub metadata.
Download the Ready Model evaluation tool or software bundle from the solution's Try Today link.

Follow the product page or evaluation package instructions to run inference on hardware, and review published metrics (memory, inference time, power) to confirm the model fits your constraints.
For DEEPCRAFT™ Voice Assistant and Audio Enhancement, use the product pages for user guides, demo firmware, and setup instructions.

boxes.heading: How to deploy
boxes.text: Ready Models are designed for integration into commercial products on Infineon MCUs and offer the shortest path from evaluation to production.

steps.text: Validate accuracy and performance on the kit and sensor configuration closest to your product.
Use the evaluation package and product documentation to embed the model in your ModusToolbox™ application on PSOC™ 6 or PSOC™ Edge.
Use published metrics as a baseline; tune thresholds, sensor placement, and power modes for your use case.
